dataStream.name: devices
dataStream.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "onlineStatus" = 'success') AS DOUBLE) * 100 / COUNT(*), 1) AS "online" FROM "dataset"

config.description: Share of devices Auvik currently reports as online
config.title: Devices Online

dataSourceConfig.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "status" = 'error') AS "open", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "status" = 'error' AND "severity[Expanded].rawState" IN ('critical', 'emergency')) AS "critical" FROM "alerts"

config.description: Alerts raised in the last 30 days that are still open, and how many of them are critical or emergency
config.title: Open Alerts

dataSourceConfig.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "devices") AS "devices", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "networks") AS "networks", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "tenants") AS "sites", (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "vendorName") FROM "devices") AS "vendors"

config.description: Devices, networks, sites and hardware vendors Auvik has discovered
config.title: Your Estate

dataStream.name: devices
dataStream.sql: WITH d AS (SELECT CASE WHEN "deviceType" = 'ups' THEN 'UPS' WHEN "deviceType" IS NULL OR "deviceType" = 'unknown' THEN 'Unclassified' ELSE UPPER(SUBSTR(REGEXP_REPLACE("deviceType", '([A-Z])', ' \1', 'g'), 1, 1)) || SUBSTR(REGEXP_REPLACE("deviceType", '([A-Z])', ' \1', 'g'), 2) END AS "type", CASE "onlineStatus[Expanded].rawState" WHEN 'online' THEN 'Online' WHEN 'offline' THEN 'Offline' WHEN 'unreachable' THEN 'Unreachable' WHEN 'lowerLayerDown' THEN 'Link down' WHEN 'dormant' THEN 'Dormant' WHEN 'testing' THEN 'Testing' WHEN 'notPresent' THEN 'Not present' ELSE 'Status unknown' END AS "status" FROM "dataset"), r AS (SELECT "type", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, "type") AS rn FROM d GROUP BY "type") SELECT CASE WHEN r.rn <= 7 THEN d."type" ELSE 'Other types' END AS "type", d."status", CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) AS "devices" FROM d JOIN r ON r."type" = d."type" GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY "devices" DESC

config.description: How each type of device is faring: every type flows into the status its devices are in, so trouble shows up as red or amber on the right
config.title: Health by Device Type

dataStream.name: devices
dataStream.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN "deviceType" = 'ups' THEN 'UPS' WHEN "deviceType" IS NULL OR "deviceType" = 'unknown' THEN 'Unclassified' ELSE UPPER(SUBSTR(REGEXP_REPLACE("deviceType", '([A-Z])', ' \1', 'g'), 1, 1)) || SUBSTR(REGEXP_REPLACE("deviceType", '([A-Z])', ' \1', 'g'), 2) END AS "type", COALESCE("vendorName", 'Unknown vendor') AS "vendor", CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) AS "devices" FROM "dataset" GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY "devices" DESC

config.description: Discovered devices grouped by device type, then vendor
config.title: Inventory by Type and Vendor

dataSourceConfig.sql: SELECT STRFTIME(DATE_TRUNC('day', "detectedOn"), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ') AS "day", UPPER(SUBSTR("severity[Expanded].rawState", 1, 1)) || SUBSTR("severity[Expanded].rawState", 2) AS "severity", CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) AS "alerts" FROM "alerts" GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY "day"

config.description: Alerts raised each day over the last 7 days, by severity
config.title: Alert Activity

dataSourceConfig.sql: SELECT "name" AS "alert", CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) AS "alerts" FROM "alerts" GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY "alerts" DESC

config.description: Which alerts fired most often over the last 7 days
config.title: Most Frequent Alerts

dataSourceConfig.sql: WITH ids AS (SELECT "entityName", "entityId", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "entityName" ORDER BY "entityId") AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY "entityName") AS dup FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "entityName", "entityId" FROM "metric")) SELECT d."timestamp", CASE WHEN i.dup > 1 THEN d."entityName" || ' #' || i.rn ELSE d."entityName" END AS "device", d."value" FROM "metric" d JOIN ids i ON d."entityId" = i."entityId" ORDER BY d."timestamp"

config.description: Devices with the highest average CPU utilization
config.title: Busiest CPUs

dataSourceConfig.sql: WITH ids AS (SELECT "entityName", "entityId", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "entityName" ORDER BY "entityId") AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY "entityName") AS dup FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "entityName", "entityId" FROM "metric")) SELECT d."timestamp", CASE WHEN i.dup > 1 THEN d."entityName" || ' #' || i.rn ELSE d."entityName" END AS "device", d."value" FROM "metric" d JOIN ids i ON d."entityId" = i."entityId" ORDER BY d."timestamp"

config.description: Devices with the highest average memory utilization
config.title: Memory Pressure

dataSourceConfig.sql: WITH ids AS (SELECT "entityName", "entityId", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "entityName" ORDER BY "entityId") AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY "entityName") AS dup FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "entityName", "entityId" FROM "metric")) SELECT d."timestamp", CASE WHEN i.dup > 1 THEN d."entityName" || ' #' || i.rn ELSE d."entityName" END AS "device", d."value" FROM "metric" d JOIN ids i ON d."entityId" = i."entityId" WHERE d."series" = 'Total' ORDER BY d."timestamp"

config.description: Devices moving the most traffic, average Mbps in and out
config.title: Top Talkers

dataSourceConfig.sql: WITH ids AS (SELECT "entityName", "entityId", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "entityName" ORDER BY "entityId") AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY "entityName") AS dup FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "entityName", "entityId" FROM "metric")) SELECT CASE WHEN i.dup > 1 THEN d."entityName" || ' #' || i.rn ELSE d."entityName" END AS "device", ROUND(ARG_MAX(d."value", d."timestamp"), 1) AS "used" FROM "metric" d JOIN ids i ON d."entityId" = i."entityId" GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY "used" DESC LIMIT 8

config.description: Devices with the highest storage utilization, latest reading
config.title: Fullest Storage

dataSourceConfig.sql: SELECT UPPER(SUBSTR("severity[Expanded].rawState", 1, 1)) || SUBSTR("severity[Expanded].rawState", 2) AS "severity", "name" AS "alert", "entityName" AS "affected", "status[Expanded].rawState" AS "state", "detectedOn", "resolvedOn", "tenantName" AS "site", "link" FROM "alerts" ORDER BY "detectedOn" DESC

config.description: Alerts raised in the last 7 days, newest first. Click a row to open the alert in Auvik
config.title: Recent Alerts

dataSourceConfig.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT "deviceName" AS "device", CASE WHEN "operationalStatus[Expanded].rawState" = 'online' THEN 'Connected' WHEN "operationalStatus[Expanded].rawState" = 'adminDown' THEN 'Disabled' ELSE 'Not connected' END AS "state" FROM "ifaces" WHERE "deviceName" IS NOT NULL AND "deviceName" NOT LIKE 'Object not found%'), top AS (SELECT "device" FROM s GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 10), agg AS (SELECT "device", "state", CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) AS "ports" FROM s WHERE "device" IN (SELECT "device" FROM top) GROUP BY "device", "state") SELECT "device", "state", "ports" FROM agg ORDER BY CASE "state" WHEN 'Connected' THEN 0 WHEN 'Not connected' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, "device"

config.description: Connected, unconnected and disabled ports on the devices with the most interfaces
config.title: Ports in Use

dataSourceConfig.sql: SELECT "timestamp", "entityName" AS "check", "value" FROM "checks" WHERE "series" = 'Average RTT' ORDER BY "timestamp"

config.description: Average round-trip time of each internet connection check
config.title: Internet Checks
